about_the_game:
This DLC contains the Dimension "New Path for Travellers". In it, you will have 5 musical themes, 5 ambient sounds and 10 stingers, all in the aesthetic of the D&D genre. All that in the palm of your hand. The Dimension details are as follows:

D0005: New Path For Travellers

Lead a small group of explorers in the search for new worlds
Paid Dimension (DLC)

- Genre: D&D

- Tracks:

  • Start (theme for the start of a adventure and travel)

  • White World (theme for a calm scenery)

  • Blue World (theme for heartfelt moments)

  • Yellow World (theme for decisive and adventurous moments)

  • Combat (theme for combat moments)

- Composer: Arlam Junior
